d: Vibrant magenta hair is tied into a high ponytail with long, flowing strands and choppy bangs framing the face. The eyes are a matching shade of magenta with a wide, startled expression, set on a youthful, adolescent face. The build is slender and petite, dressed in a white short-sleeved shirt with navy blue trim and navy blue shorts. Signature details include a white rectangular bandage on the right cheek and a large, dark grey mechanical submarine-themed apparatus strapped to the torso.
